description_en: Twodharmadhātujinālaya caityas, commonly referred to aschaturamukha caitya(i.e acaityawhich has four faces) and adharmadhātu maṇḍalaarelocated on the western side of the main road at Hitipusaḥ Jaḥrũ, Dampāchẽ, Sunāguthi. Four Buddha images sit on top of the upward opening lotus blossoms above a single layer of petals. These blossoms are supported by a lion throne positioned on top of a square pedestal which in turn sits upon the square plinth. A drum, a dome and a finial have been placed above the four Buddha images. Thecaityasare 200 cm in height. An octagonal shapeddharmadhātumaṇḍala(80 cm in height) lies to their west.
description_ne: सुनागुठी दम्पाछेँ हितिफुसः जःरुँको मूलबाटोको पश्चिमपट्टि दुईवटा धर्मधातुजिनालय चैत्य र एउटा धर्मधातु मण्डल रहेका छन् । २०० सेमी उचाइ रहेका चैत्यमा वेदीमाथि चारसुरमा सिंह रहेको वेदिका र त्यसमाथि रहेको माथितिर फर्केको कमलपुष्पको आसनमाथि पुनः चारसुरमा सिंह रहेको वेदिका र त्यसमाथि चारतिर फर्केका बुद्धका चार मूर्ति रहेका छन् । ती मूर्तिमाथि कुम्भ भागमा बुद्धका साना चार मूर्ति रहेका छन्, त्यसमाथि हर्मिका र त्रयोदशभुवन रहेका छन् । चैत्यहरूको पश्चिमपट्टि एउटा ८० सेमी अग्लो अष्टकोणाकार धर्मधातु मण्डल रहेको छ ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)

historical_events.event_description: The inscription is unreadable. However, given the dates of other similardharmadhātujinālaya caitya,it could be that this monument was built around 1979 CE.
With the exception of the dates, the inscription is unreadable.
